name: claude-code-mods
description: Six Claude Code mods: context routing, effort and model selection, cache keep-warm, handoffs and a switchboard panel.

plugins.name: input-router
plugins.description: Condenses Read and MCP outputs over ~2,000 tokens to relevant excerpts with Haiku.

plugins.name: effort-optimizer
plugins.description: Rates each prompt with Sonnet and suggests or sets low/medium/high effort.

plugins.name: subagent-model-selector
plugins.description: Routes subagents to Haiku, Sonnet or Opus by task difficulty.

plugins.name: cache-clock
plugins.description: Prompt-cache countdown above the prompt, with /keepwarm.

plugins.name: handoff
plugins.description: Writes a handover prompt for a new session at 250k tokens or on /handoff.

plugins.name: switchboard
plugins.description: Side panel with ON/OFF switches and settings for every mod.
